title: Unhandled promise rejection during graceful shutdown with keep-alive connections
body:
When calling `server.close()` while clients maintain active keep-alive HTTP/1.1 connections, Node 22 throws an unhandled rejection in the connection pool handler.

Error stack:
```
Error: Connection reset by peer
    at Socket.onSocketClose (node:net:382:12)
    at Server.closePool (src/pool.ts:45:9)
```

Expected behavior: Active connections should drain gracefully or terminate without unhandled rejections.
author: dev-contributor
